description: Find hotels with a room free for the dates and guests. Returns each stay's cheapest fitting room with a quote (price, ATA fee 5%, typical 15-20% OTA cut). Demo hotels are marked demo: true. Results come in pages: when more_results is true, call search_stays again with the same arguments plus cursor: next_cursor to get the rest. Nothing is left out.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of this same search, to get the next page

guests.description: Number of guests in one room

max_price_per_night.description: Budget per night in the hotel's currency (EUR in the demo)

place.description: City, area, country or hotel name, e.g. 'Bangkok' or 'Gamla Stan'

name: search_stays
title: Search stays
